hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; ACTIVE=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('stop_hook_active', False))" 2>/dev/null || echo False); [ "$ACTIVE" = "True" ] && exit 0; [ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src scripts 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; npm run gates >/tmp/lg-gates.log 2>&1 && exit 0; echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Uncommitted changes under src/ or scripts/ fail `npm run gates`. Log: /tmp/lg-gates.log. Fix them, or say explicitly why the work is being left red."}'
